channel.title: Methodology Feed
channel.description: Aggregated research articles from Nature Biotechnology and Nature Methods.

item.title: Nature Biotechnology: Scalable single-cell total RNA sequencing unifies coding and noncoding transcriptomics
item.description: Nature Biotechnology, Published online: 31 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03068-6 Simultaneous profiling of adenylated and non-adenylated RNAs reveals regulatory programs across diverse cell types.

item.title: Nature Biotechnology: Mirror-enhanced 4Pi-SMLM with one objective enables isotropic nanoscale imaging
item.description: Nature Biotechnology, Published online: 31 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03083-7 Single-molecule 4Pi microscopy is simplified and made accessible by using a single objective.

item.title: Nature Methods: Next-gen micropillars for investigating oligodendrocyte myelination
item.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 30 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03041-w Tunable hydrogel-based micropillar arrays are fabricated to model the biomechanical cues of size, shape and rigidity characteristic of axons. These next-gen micropillars allow the exquisite examination of the cell biology of oligodendroglia, resolving the myelinogenic potential, myelin extent and kinetics of wrapping in a cell-autonomous manner.

item.title: Nature Methods: SNP calling, haplotype phasing and allele-specific analysis with long RNA-seq reads
item.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 30 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03045-6 In this study, long-read RNA sequencing achieves accurate single-nucleotide polymorphism calling, haplotype phasing and allele-specific expression analysis.

item.title: Nature Methods: Tunable hydrogel-based micropillar arrays for myelination studies
item.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 30 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03048-3 To study myelination in vitro, a hydrogel-based micropillar array is used to mimic the stiffness and diameter of axons, with variations in these properties allowing evaluation of their influence. The platform can also be used to assess the effects of putative remyelination drugs.

item.title: Nature Methods: Compressing the collective knowledge of ESM into a single protein language model
item.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 30 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03050-9 A co-distillation framework is used to iteratively adapt sequence-only protein language models for high-accuracy variant effect prediction, without the need for additional structural or genetic data. Individual protein language models therefore self-improve by distilling the most confident predictions from multiple models, achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple variant effect prediction benchmarks.

item.title: Nature Methods: Differentiation of sphingomyelin and cholesterol by hyperspectral mid-infrared detection of single-bond vibrational modes in the fingerprint region
item.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 30 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03025-w Hyperspectral fingerprint optoacoustic microscopy enables the differentiation of different lipid classes in living cells, which is of interest in the study of lipid metabolism in health and disease.

item.title: Nature Biotechnology: Unpaired data as a first-order challenge in single-cell and spatial proteomics
item.description: Nature Biotechnology, Published online: 27 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03074-8 Unpaired data as a first-order challenge in single-cell and spatial proteomics

item.title: Nature Biotechnology: Mapping cis -regulatory mutations at scale in sorghum enables modulation of gene expression
item.description: Nature Biotechnology, Published online: 27 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03046-y Variant mapping of sorghum promoters identifies CRISPR-accessible mutations that upregulate gene expression.

item.title: Nature Biotechnology: High-resolution metagenome assembly for modern long reads with myloasm
item.description: Nature Biotechnology, Published online: 27 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03053-z A long-read metagenome assembly method recovers circular and complete genomes better than existing tools.

item.title: Nature Biotechnology: DNA–drug conjugates enable logic-gated drug delivery amplified by hybridization chain reactions
item.description: Nature Biotechnology, Published online: 27 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03044-0 New capabilities for controlling drug delivery into cells are developed using DNA–drug conjugates.
